thread:
amy-recruiter: Tags: AJ starts 2026-07-06. Spouse is in AOS (adjustment of status) and filed an I-485 about 4 weeks ago. AJ asked if we can add spouse to medical at hire if SSN hasn't come through. @lucas-peopleops could we do an exception?
lucas-peopleops: Short: vendors sometimes accept I-485 receipt as evidence for dependent eligibility; need docs (I-797C + marriage cert). Usually vendor will request SSN later. Uploads?
aj-newhire: Uploaded I-797C receipt, marriage cert, passport to the candidate folder: https://drive.company/boxed/aj/imm. Receipt ends with 4421. Want to avoid COBRA gap.
benefits-bot: Vendor note: Anthem/CoverageAdmin accept receipt for provisional enrollment in many cases but require SSN within 60 days. If SSN not provided vendor may retro-bill.
imm-legal: Legal perspective: Document receipt in employee file and set follow-up tickler for 45 days. If SSN/EAD never issued, revoke dependent coverage per plan terms. Keep audit trail.
lucas-peopleops: Operationally we can request provisional enrollment and mark the case "pending SSN". Finance sign-off needed if we front employer portion of premiums while SSN pending. @rachael-finance?
rachael-finance: We prefer not to front costs >30 days routinely. However we can approve a one-time exception to cover employer share for up to 45 days for new hires in AOS, provided recruiting files a short business justification and we tag cost center 3201. Please include statement: "Cover employer share pending SSN for up to 45 days for AJ (start 2026-07-06)."
aj-newhire: Thank you! I'll ask Amy to add that note. If SSN comes through after 45 days do I upload to drive or email benefits?
lucas-peopleops: Upload to the same drive and also email benefits@redwood with subject line "AJ - dependent SSN update". We'll update vendor record and payroll.
amy-recruiter: Added finance justification note to the folder and flagged cost center 3201. Also added a short timeline note.
benefits-bot: Payroll note: premiums will be deducted starting on initial payroll after enrollment. If vendor applies retro charges we will offset or reimburse per finance approval.
imm-legal: Add: maintain a record: "Provisional dependent enrollment with I-485 receipt dated [date]; SSN pending; employer share covered up to 45 days per finance exception."
lucas-peopleops: I'll open the Anthem case and post the vendor case number here by COB tomorrow. We will proceed with provisional enrollment and mark payroll/HRIS accordingly.
rachael-finance: Exception recorded. Notify me if enrollment extends beyond 45 days.
aj-newhire: Really appreciate the help. Start date stays 7/6. :smile:
